Leo: FYI a customer reported quota attribution noise. console shows traffic attributed to `route:priority-low` but our SDK traces (py/ts) say `priority_high`. :confused:
Maya: Any sample headers or payloads? could be our splitting of `X-Route-Tag` vs `X-Route-Policy`.
Leo: captured from their edge proxy:
```
x-route-tag: priority-low
X-Route-Policy: priority_high
X-Client: sdk-go/0.9.1
```
Tom: ah classic: older SDKs set policy into `X-Route-Policy` underscored style, newer infra uses tag state. Ingestion chooses policy first and falls back to tag, but the proxy dedupe logic prefers the lowercased header entry.
Nina: We also discovered our quota engine normalizes hyphens->underscores when hashing keys, which can make `priority-high` and `priority_high` collide unpredictably in the dashboard.
Maya: Proposed mitigations: 1) ingestion: implement deterministic precedence (policy > tag > body) and canonicalize separators (prefer hyphen) before hashing; 2) add a short-lived telemetry field `x-route-resolution` with `resolved_by=ingest|proxy|sdk` so metrics teams can filter; 3) patch proxy to canonicalize header casing in the gateway (canary).
Tom: For SDKs: add non-breaking header aliasing in the next minor (emit both `X-Route-Policy` and `X-Route-Tag` until EOL). Avoid breaking in patch.
Leo: Can we do ingestion change today? it's low-risk. ingest-bot: Deploying ingest hotfix to cluster: platform-ingest-2 - begun.
Nina: Dashboards: we'll need to update the quota grouping rule to use canonicalized key and add a note on the alert. Otherwise on-call will get pages for historical re-aggregations.
Maya: Rollout plan: ingestion hotfix (today) -> proxy canary (this week) -> SDK aliasing in next minor (sprint after). I'll own proxy canary.
Tom: I'll put a short blurb in the SDK changelog and open an issue for alias removal after two minor releases.
Leo: Assigning follow-ups: Maya (proxy canary + telemetry header spec), Tom (SDK changelog + issue), Nina (dashboard rule + runbook). Thanks all. :pray:
